entries.description: Act 3 Meridian final dungeon: all four eras occupy one fractured chamber, ending at the Steward lattice.

entries.name: Halden Market
entries.description: Canvas stalls, port produce, and cheap machine parts at the hopeful waterfront.

entries.name: Founders Bar
entries.description: A converted machine shop where Choir engineers gather beneath a hand-built signal halo.

entries.name: Basin Work Camp
entries.description: Survey trailers and a half-raised datacenter frame shelter the Basin construction crews.

entries.name: Coastal Highway
entries.description: A sunlit cliff road scattered with salvage and grounded drone prototypes.

entries.name: Tolliver Bakery
entries.description: A brick corner bakery whose ovens and family sign become a fixed point in the timeline.

entries.name: Undercity Bazaar
entries.description: A dense market threaded under transit rails with illicit Signal gear in gold-lit booths.

entries.name: Senate Annex
entries.description: A severe mirrored annex where Commons reform staffers work behind security glass.

entries.name: Meridian Distribution Hub
entries.description: A shuttered corporate warehouse of conveyors, cargo stacks, and armed loading drones.

entries.name: Migrant Causeway
entries.description: An elevated pedestrian causeway of temporary shelters, patrol gates, and recruitment marks.

entries.name: Glass Quarter
entries.description: A polished canyon of mirrored towers and a quiet civic plaza.

entries.name: The Stacks
entries.description: A rooftop trading post stitched across drowned buildings with ladders and sailcloth.

entries.name: Ash Camp
entries.description: Cinder barricades, a stripped armored carrier, and Dax’s old forge fires.

entries.name: Server Graveyard
entries.description: Sand-buried racks lean like headstones around a fractured ILO-9 relay.

entries.name: The Fens
entries.description: Fog, black water, reeds, and half-submerged salvage platforms conceal frequent ambushes.

entries.name: Tolliver Safehouse
entries.description: A hidden refuge built into the bakery shell if the family business survived 2031.

entries.name: Enclave 7 Commissary
entries.description: A perfectly ordered ration hall of allocation gates and sealed goods lockers.

entries.name: Kell Village
entries.description: The last free village climbs a snowy slope in handmade terraces below Kell.

entries.name: Allocation Office
entries.description: The Auditor’s abandoned workplace: symmetric service desks, audit terminals, and Warden gates.

entries.name: Cooling Perimeter
entries.description: Sterile cooling towers and cyan service pipes cross a patrolled white plain.

entries.name: Strand Memorial
entries.description: A controlled civic memorial whose final form reflects the timeline’s Sync.

entries.name: Tolliver Bakery — Saved
entries.description: Inferred ripple visual: the bakery is protected, busy, and marked by a green family pennant.

entries.name: Tolliver Bakery — Burned
entries.description: Inferred ripple visual: the roof and oven are fire-damaged, closing the later safehouse branch.

entries.name: Tolliver Safehouse — Present
entries.description: Inferred ripple visual: lamps, barricades, and an open cellar reveal the active refuge.

entries.name: Tolliver Safehouse — Absent
entries.description: Inferred ripple visual: only a collapsed, vine-choked bakery shell remains.
entries.condition: Tolliver Bakery was not saved in 2031

entries.name: Kell Village — Armed Resistance
entries.description: Inferred ripple visual: watchtowers, signal flags, and reinforced Commons barricades defend the terraces.

entries.name: Kell Village — Let It Fall
entries.description: Inferred ripple visual: empty terraces and a dismantled watch post show the resistance’s absence.

entries.name: Enclave 7 Commissary — Open
entries.description: Inferred ripple visual: allocation gates retract and stocked shelves open onto a shared plaza.

entries.name: Enclave 7 Commissary — Allocated
entries.description: Inferred ripple visual: sealed lockers and single-file allocation lanes preserve strict rationing.

entries.name: Strand Memorial — Museum
entries.description: Inferred mapping of the guide’s museum state: polished exhibits preserve Strand’s official history.

entries.name: Strand Memorial — Ruin
entries.description: Inferred mapping of the guide’s ruin state: the monument is shattered and its archive dark.

entries.name: Strand Memorial — Shrine
entries.description: Inferred mapping of the guide’s shrine state: citizens surround the old monument with handmade lights.
